meta_description: Painter4u Southampton offers interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Local painter with free quotes and attention to detail.
hero_subhead: Professional interior and exterior painting across Southampton. Free quotes, no mess, stunning results.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services in Southampton
services_subhead: From room refreshes to full exterior transformations, we handle every paintwork project with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Bedroom, lounge, kitchen, and bathroom painting using premium finishes. We prep properly, protect your furniture, and leave no mess behind.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior paint for fascias, soffits, doors, and walls. We use trade-grade paints that last, even in Southampton's damp climate.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Pattern matching, feature walls, and full-room papering. We remove old paper cleanly and hang new with precision for a polished finish.

services.title: Woodwork & Staining
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, and window frames painted or stained to bring out natural wood grain or match your colour scheme exactly.

services.title: Textured Coatings
services.desc: Artex removal, polished plaster, and decorative finishes to add character and hide imperfections in aging walls.

services.title: Maintenance Repaints
services.desc: Regular repaints to refresh tired rooms or protect exterior surfaces. We assess damage, prepare surfaces, and apply lasting colour.

about_pullquote: We treat every home like it's our own. That's how we work.
about_para_1: Painter4u has been transforming Southampton homes for over a decade. Started by a tradesperson frustrated with sloppy finish work, we've grown on the back of meticulous surface prep, quality paints, and customers who recommend us to their neighbours. We're based locally on Beechmount Road and pride ourselves on showing up on time, working clean, and leaving your home looking like you've just moved in.
about_para_2: Repeat customers make up over 70% of our work — a sign that we deliver on our promises. You won't get rushed paint jobs or cut corners here. We take time to understand your vision, source the right finishes for your space, and ensure every wall, door, and trim is finished to gallery standards.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the hallway and stairs redecorated. The lads were brilliant — minimal fuss, protective sheets everywhere, and the finish is flawless. Looks like a brand-new house. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: We needed our kitchen repainted and weren't sure about colour. James spent time explaining finishes and helped us pick something that actually suits the room. Work was tidy, timely, and excellent value. Will definitely have them back.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Exterior of the house needed work badly. They sorted the fascias, soffits, and redecorated the front door. Three weeks later it still looks pristine. Professional outfit. No complaints whatsoever.
reviews.author: David L.
